description: Land Acquisition - Compensations for the acquired lands - Case Nos. LA 00008/14, DLA 00053/13, LA 00071/13 and LA 02/14 of District Court Kandy in Akurana D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically notices under Section 33 regarding compensation payments for acquired lands. The content includes detailed land descriptions (names, plan numbers, lot numbers, extents, and boundaries) but does not involve government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. The primary focus is on land matters, making it a clear Type 4 (Land Gazette).
